description.value: Fort Street Cycle is a locally owned full-service bike shop in Victoria that has been helping cyclists since 1992. They carry BMC, Cannondale, and Orbea bikes and a curated selection of components and apparel, backed by a team of qualified mechanics capable of everything from minor adjustments to full frame-up rebuilds. A touring cyclist arriving with a mechanical will find a shop with genuine depth — multiple service tiers, suspension work, wheel building, and drivetrain overhaul all on the menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and fully fetched, confirming a legitimate full-service bike shop at 1025 Fort St, Victoria, operating since 1992. The services page explicitly lists e-bike flat repair, a full mechanic team, and language like 'Come on down and bring us your repairs, we will get you back on the road or trail before you know it' supports walk-in and urgent repair claims. No explicit evidence for pump, washrooms, rentals, DIY stand, or most other optional amenities.
